name: test_task_title_exceeding_limit_is_rejected
description: Verifies that a title over the documented 20-char limit is rejected, not silently accepted.
descriptionHtml: Verifies that a title over the documented 20-char limit is rejected, not silently accepted.
statusMessage:
XFAIL TM-07 (docs/known-defects-and-improvements.md): a 21-char title is silently accepted instead of being rejected - the documented 20-char limit is not enforced. Remove xfail once the defect is fixed.

AssertionError: expected status 400, got 200 (body: {
      "date": "2026-10-04T19:46:17.581436Z", 
      "done": false, 
      "id": 19, 
      "tags": [], 
      "title": "b4833db9d9414a3eabe6c", 
      "username": "QA"
  }
  )
assert 200 == 400
 +  where 200 = <Response [200]>.status_code
